step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram depicts a data ingestion and analytics pipeline starting from smart TVs. 1. A Smart TV (UserConsumerTV) sends log, performance, and user telemetry data to Amazon Kinesis. 2. Amazon Kinesis pipes the incoming streams into Amazon Kinesis Firehose. 3. Kinesis Firehose dumps raw data into Amazon S3 for long-term storage and loads structured data into Amazon RedShift data warehouse. 4. Amazon RedShift connects to Amazon QuickSight for reporting and data visualization. All AWS service names strictly match the provided schema string list.
